ns2:course.label: Instructional Supervision
ns2:course.description: Methods, theories, and research applying to the supervision and evaluation of classroom instruction; includes analysis and application of research in effective teaching practices, formative and summative evaluation, staff development, data collection techniques, and alternative feedback methods. Prerequisite: EOL 540 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: EOL 540 or consent of instructor.
